Scale: the plate is square and appears to be about 22-24 cm across, and it is cropped in the photo. The fruit chunks are roughly 2.5-3 cm cubes.

Watermelon: I count about 12 pieces. That includes 2 at top left, 1 small piece at the top center, 1 at the top, and about 8 in the cluster on the right. A 3 cm cube weighs about 27 cm³ × 0.95 ≈ 25 g. Some pieces are smaller, so the average is about 22 g. 12 × 22 ≈ 265 g, which I'll lower to about 250 g.

Pineapple: I count about 13 pieces. They are smaller, around 3×2×1.5 cm, so about 10-15 g each. That gives roughly 13 × 14 ≈ 180 g.
